author: Wang Runyuan

configuration.casState: cold/fresh Durable Object per route measurement
configuration.routeOrder: five-repeat cyclic rotation; every route occupies every order position

H1_structuralRouting.threshold: adaptive selections = 22 single / 6 multi / 12 full; zero fallback

H2_windowBound.threshold: adaptive windows <= 10% of raw multi for rangeCount >= 16

H3_scanReduction.threshold: adaptive scan bytes <= 70% of raw multi for rangeCount >= 16

H4_latencyReduction.threshold: adaptive total <= 80% of raw multi for rangeCount >= 16

H5_boundedRegret.threshold: adaptive <= 125% of fastest forced route in at least 70% of scenarios

H6_sparseStorage.threshold: COW peaks equal; adaptive peak <= 15% materialized; retained growth equal

H7_scanBudget.threshold: adaptive scan <= one file in every scenario; zero budget fallback

H8_correctness.threshold: all 1,005 executions correct and all 40 scenarios retained-growth consistent

interpretationLimits: equal-weighted sums of per-scenario medians are synthetic summaries, not workload-weighted production estimates
five repetitions balance route order but do not establish production latency distributions or statistical significance
engine timing excludes Computer RPC, computerd, FUSE, diff construction, native disk, network transfer, concurrent agents, and warm CAS
full-scan fallback reconstructs a contiguous file buffer in memory; scan bytes and window count alone do not measure allocation, copying, or working-set cost
the frozen policy was not changed after the formal run; failed latency hypotheses are retained
